title: fix: preserve saved community model prices during private edits
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: Editing a private community model no longer clears its saved public pricing, even when the only change is its title. Private models remain free to use at runtime; modality and image-pricing filtering, along with public-model visible-field filtering, are unchanged. A regression test checks that a private model title edit submits the retained prices.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli wears tiny reading glasses and renames a private model on a retro terminal while its saved pricing rests safely in a closed drawer beside a code-plant. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She is small-to-medium sized, sharing the frame with the workspace; strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) accents.
